test_title: PYST 09: SSC Stenographer 2025: General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which option figure will replace the question mark in the following series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/512fbb7b375b230bf9f7cd410254346f9ae267ba6c36270c5ea76766ba2bea1f.png]
solution:
1) B and D are moved alternatively. B is rotated 90° anticlockwise and D is rotated 90°clockwise.

In next step B is rotated 90° clockwise and D is rotated 90°anticlockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3d435ea93cdeefd3a8f4e85de1f735c79c6e3cf7ee8696e273fb7ae5b006ea6.png] 

2) F and Z are moved alternatively. Z is rotated 90° clockwise and F is rotated 90° clockwise.

In next step Z and F rotated anticlockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17ec369e35041655b88c043edaed11f3026c22e7e21bcc8a18b060d55ec86c47.png] 

3) Middle figure is rotated 90° clockwise in each step.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98d2549b855963f49ea0bd2925000213dc8b77e7ea8db50ebf2aaacc39186468.png] 

So, next figure is;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf8952607abed3ec032e4e0fe41e8bc5453534b98ecb983d03b519ea61fca3d9.png] 

Hence, **option (2)** is the correct answer.
